title: Teduray language
description: Austronesian language spoken in the Philippines
extract: Teduray or Tiruray is an Austronesian language of the southern Philippines spoken by the Teduray people, in the Datu Blah T. Sinsuat and Upi municipalities, South Upi municipality, and Lebak municipality.
